location_exception_reason: Container fabrication is a nationwide service; buyers select fabricators based on technical capability, material quality, and delivery timeline, not geographic origin. Location in titles is redundant noise.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words ('Manufacturer', 'Fabricator', 'Service Provider') are integral to this MCAT — they signal production capability and custom-build capacity, which are core buyer decision factors distinct from pre-built product sales. Removing these words leaves the title ambiguous (e.g., 'Container Cabin' could mean resale of stock units vs. custom fabrication).
